author: Aletheia I
title: Aletheia I - Extract Anscombe HVG List for Enrichment Analysis
abstract: A diagnostic experiment to extract the full list of 2000 Highly Variable Genes (HVGs) selected after Anscombe normalization, using the SOTA's HVG selection parameters. This list will be used for an external gene enrichment analysis, as suggested by reviewer feedback (Archive ID 32), to investigate the biological basis for Anscombe's improvement in `ASW_label`.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
import numpy as np
import scanpy as sc

sys.path.append('storage/aletheia')
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import get_hvg_list

def test(adata: ad.AnnData):
    """
    Extracts the HVG list after Anscombe normalization.
    """
    print("Aletheia I: Extracting HVG list after Anscombe Normalization for external analysis.")
    
    hvg_anscombe = get_hvg_list(adata.copy(), normalization_method='anscombe', n_top_genes=2000)
    print(f"Number of HVGs (Anscombe): {len(hvg_anscombe)}")
    print("\n--- Full HVG List (Anscombe) for External Analysis ---")
    for gene in hvg_anscombe:
        print(gene)
    print("--- End of HVG List ---")
    
    return "HVG list extraction diagnostic completed. Check logs for details and copy the list."
